Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the shared genre was “post-punk,” asserting that INXS is explicitly a post-punk band. The sources shown list INXS’s genres as new wave, pub rock, dance-rock, funk rock, and alternative rock—no post-punk. This misreading led to choosing the wrong intersection; a supported common genre would be new wave (and broadly rock), not post-punk.
